text:
During multiple sprint sports, ADP degradation via the adenylate kinase reaction raises blood concentrations of AMP and, through further deamination, inosine monophosphate (IMP) and its catabolites (inosine, hypoxanthine, xanthine, uric acid); ammonia also rises. The most commonly cited blood markers of this degradation are hypoxanthine and uric acid (with ammonia reflecting AMP deamination).  
CONFIDENCE: 78
